title: Universal target whole-cochain scalar reduction counit
statement: Fix a prime ell, finite extensions E and F of Q_ell, a Q_ell-algebra map i:E→F, and a scheme W. Use the canonical constant coefficient tensor T and ordinary tensor from [def-pur-constant-scalar-tensor-data], and native ordinary reduction, exact restriction to constant coefficients, the reduction functor D_E, and its whole-system counit from [def-pur-native-reduction-counit-data]. For any recorded derived-system calculus S over F and any natural number e, let r_e select the levels e(n+1)-1 and R_e its exact derived functor. Put C=ordinary completed scalar extension and LC=its canonical total left derived functor, using [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. There exists a natural transformation alpha:Q(LC D_F R_e)→(C O_F r_e)Q whose component is R_e D_F applied to the completed scalar-extension counit, then R_e applied to the F constant reduction counit on C(P), then the exact arithmetic-restriction localization factor. The pair (LC D_F R_e,alpha) is a right Kan extension of the ordinary composite followed by Q along Q. This makes no comparison with E reduction and assumes no ramification equality. The completed coefficient map is the actual map fixed by its finite reductions in [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison].

source.place: Lemma derived-base-change (Tag 06YY), lemma-derived-pullback-composition, section-derived-limits (0940), lemma-derived-limit-is-ok (0941); derived.tex, lemma-derived-adjoint-functors. Specialization of the original balancing theorem docstring to its target composite.

proof.text: Build the whole-cochain counit natural transformation by transporting systemReductionCounit through quotientCompQhIso and mapHomotopyCategoryFactors, whiskering with exact systemRestriction and arithmetic restriction, and precomposing the scalar-extension counit. Functor associators have identity components, so its component is exactly the displayed formula.

Choose a K-flat resolution P of each E-complex. The specified completed extension C preserves K-flatness. Its canonical counit is invertible on P, and the native F counit is invertible on C(P) by the native K-flat computation. Exact restriction functors have invertible localization factors and preserve isomorphisms. Thus the composite cochain counit is invertible on all K-flat P.

Prove the universal property on the homotopy category. For any V and eta:Q V→F, define eta times the inverse of the computing counit on K-flat representatives. The resolving-class natural-transformation theorem extends these components uniquely over the homotopy category. Fully faithful localization whiskering descends that transformation to V→D. Resolve an arbitrary object and cancel its inverted resolution map to prove the factorization and uniqueness equations. This makes (D,alpha) terminal in the right-extension category. Finally full and faithful whiskering with the homotopy quotient and the canonical quotient/localization isomorphisms transfer this right Kan extension to the cochain category.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarTargetCounit_universal (W : Scheme.{u})
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l F W) (e : ℕ) :
    letI := ordinaryReduction_additive l F W
    letI := systemRestriction_additive l F W
    let O := ordinaryReduction l F W ⋙ systemRestriction l F W
    letI : O.Additive := inferInstanceAs
      ((ordinaryReduction l F W ⋙ systemRestriction l F W).Additive)
    let γ (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l F W) ℤ) :=
      S.reduction.map ((DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).inv.app P) ≫
        (systemReductionCounit l F W S).app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj P) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Qh.map
          (((ordinaryReduction l F W).mapHomotopyCategoryFactors (.up ℤ)).hom.app P) ≫
        (DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).hom.app
          (((ordinaryReduction l F W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
    let δ (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l F W) ℤ) :
        (reduction l F W S).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ⟶
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((O.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) :=
      (systemU l F W).map (γ P) ≫
        (systemRestriction l F W).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
          (((ordinaryReduction l F W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
    let r := CategoryTheory.StrictTowerArithmetic.restriction
      (Modules (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l F)) W) e
    let R := CategoryTheory.StrictTowerArithmetic.derivedRestriction
      (Modules (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l F)) W) e
    let C := pbcExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E F i W)
    letI : (C ⋙ O ⋙ r).Additive := inferInstance
    let D := pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E F i W) ⋙ reduction l F W S ⋙ R
    ∃ α : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ D ⟶
        ((C ⋙ O ⋙ r).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q,
      (∀ P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E W) ℤ,
        α.app P = R.map
            ((reduction l F W S).map (pbcComplexCounit (completedCoefficientMap l E F i W) P)) ≫
          R.map (δ ((C.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)) ≫
          r.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
            ((O.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
              ((C.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))) ∧
      D.IsRightKanExtension α
